title: The Mirror
subtitle: A *My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic* × Project Elysian crossover (off-canon). Working title.
author: Project Elysian
description: Five Kin, pulled through a broken mirror into Equestria, and the four weeks after: the Crusaders' secret, a town that doesn't know what to make of them, and a Cluster learning what there is to eat.
